title: Safe Pilot
tagline: Lead a glowing drone swarm through a rock storm. A safety filter slides every drone around danger while you chase combos.

paper.title: Convex Safety Filtering via Spectral Selection for Nonconvex Safe Sets

novelty: An arcade game whose core mechanic is a per-obstacle half-space velocity-projection safety filter (control-barrier style) made visible as glowing arcs; no known implementation (not verified).
description: A neon arcade game: steer a swarm with your pointer, skim asteroids for near-miss combos, collect stars to grow the swarm, survive escalating waves.
howItWorks: Each drone chases its formation slot, then its desired velocity is projected onto the safe half-space of every obstacle (relative velocity along the obstacle normal must be at least minus alpha times the clearance) plus arena walls, in a few Gauss-Seidel passes. The projection is the safety filter idea from the paper; the swarm and game are a toy, not the paper experiments.
controls: Move the mouse or drag a finger to steer the swarm. Tap or press Space to start and restart.
